item.title: In How to Make Money in Stocks, O'Neil treated the "M" (Market direction) as a d
item.description:
In How to Make Money in Stocks, O'Neil treated the "M" (Market direction) as a decisive filter: strong stock selection cannot overcome a falling general market.

Roughly three out of four stocks will fall along with the broader market averages when the overall market trend is down, even if those stocks have strong fundamentals.

The M in CANSLIM is very important!

item.title: Wins and losses are equally a part of investing. The net result is ALL that matt
item.description:
Wins and losses are equally a part of investing. The net result is ALL that matters.

"If you haven't found that place in yourself, then it's very hard to accept losses. And if you cannot accept the negative consequences, you'll never succeed as a trader" - Tharp

"Most successful speculators have a success rate below 50%" - Tharp

The biggest indicator of a phony investor on X is that fact that they have to be right vs admitting their losses.
